items.title: Broken Link
items.text:
Broken Link:
After discarding this card, any player may discard a Player card to stop drawing Infection cards for the rest of this turn.
(This has no effect during setup and epidemics.)

mechanics.timing: after this Infection card is discarded
mechanics.effect: Any player may discard a Player card to stop drawing Infection cards for the rest of this turn.
restrictions: This has no effect during setup and epidemics.

items.title: Lockdown
items.text:
Lockdown:
If this card is in the Infection discard pile, any player may discard a Player card to destroy this card at any time.

mechanics.trigger: If this card is in the Infection discard pile
mechanics.effect: Any player may discard a Player card to destroy this card.
restrictions: This card must be in the Infection discard pile
